policies.title: A planet occupying the house it rules is not read as a malefic occupant of that house
policies.existingRule: house.lord-placement.own-house reads the lord in its own house as protecting it (positive), while house.occupant.malefic reads the same planet in the same house as friction (negative): two registered rules make opposite claims from one fact about one house (121 incompatible claims on seed 99).
policies.proposedInterpretation: Where the occupant rules the house it occupies, the more specific own-house rule governs; the generic malefic-occupant item is treated as neutral (no harm counted). Its positive own-house item is unchanged and no new weight is added.

sources.reference: house.lord-placement.own-house: 'A house lord occupying its own house protects and strengthens that house.'
Rule specificity: a rule about the house's own lord is narrower than the generic natural-malefic rule for the same fact and house.
BPHS-based commentary and a Tajika text (Hillaya Deepika) describe a house as strengthened by its own lord's presence or aspect; the 'even when malefic' case is not confirmed in a primary edition.

exceptions: Applies only to the house the occupant rules; a malefic occupying another house of the area is unchanged.
Rahu and Ketu own no house and are never covered.
The upachaya branch (already positive) is unchanged.

policies.title: Saturn's or Mars's aspect on a house it rules is not read as pressure
policies.existingRule: house.aspect.saturn-mars reads Saturn's or Mars's aspect on any non-upachaya house as pressure, including a house the aspecting planet rules.
policies.proposedInterpretation: Treat the aspect as neutral when the aspecting planet rules the aspected house (diagnostic what-if only).

sources.reference: Commentary on BPHS bhava strength names the strength of a house's own lord among its supports; a Tajika text holds a house strong when aspected by its own lord.
Whether a natural malefic lord's aspect protects without also pressuring is not confirmed in a primary edition.

exceptions: Only the house the aspecting planet rules.

policies.title: One planet's dignity counted once per life area
policies.existingRule: house.lord-dignity and karaka.dignity both apply dignityDirection to the same dignity fact; a planet that rules two houses of an area, or rules an area house and signifies the area, has that one reading counted two or three times.
policies.proposedInterpretation: Count the planet's dignity reading once per area (the strongest item), the rest neutral (diagnostic what-if only).

sources.reference: yoga.domain: 'One item per yoga name per domain: repeated formations confirm, they do not multiply.'
resolveDomain counts confirmations by independent source (confirmedBy), not by item.
Bhava analysis judges the house, its lord and its karaka as separate factors; whether one planet holding two of these roles counts once or twice is not settled.

exceptions: A period lord's condition (timing) is not a natal dignity reading and is never merged.

policies.title: Combustion of a planet in exaltation, own sign or moolatrikona
policies.existingRule: dignityDirection ignores combustion below a strong dignity (positive); planetCondition subtracts one for combustion (period capacity). The engine reads the same pair two ways.
policies.proposedInterpretation: None proposed: neither the size nor the direction of the effect has a documented basis.

sources.reference: Combustion is widely held to weaken a planet; how it interacts with exaltation or own sign is not settled across sources.

policies.title: A cancelled debilitation: neutral strength, or a Raja Yoga
policies.existingRule: Lord/karaka dignity reads a cancelled debilitation as neutral; the Neecha Bhanga Raja Yoga item counts it as a strong positive yoga in career and leadership.
policies.proposedInterpretation: None proposed; the two readings answer different questions (strength restored vs yoga formed).

sources.reference: Texts differ on which cancellation conditions form a Raja Yoga and for which areas.

policies.title: A debilitated or combust participant and the yoga it forms
policies.existingRule: Yoga items do not read participant dignity or combustion (only dusthana placement weakens them).
policies.proposedInterpretation: None proposed: no documented rule says by how much a weak participant reduces a yoga.

sources.reference: Formation is not taken to guarantee results; the reduction for a weak participant is not quantified in a verified source.

policies.title: One period capacity applied to every linked area
policies.existingRule: dasha.running-lord gives every linked area the same direction (planetCondition), whether the lord rules, occupies or signifies the area.
policies.proposedInterpretation: None proposed: an area-specific period rule would be a new formula.

sources.reference: Period results are classically read through the lord's houses, placement and dignity together; no verified area-by-area formula is encoded.

policies.title: Rahu or Ketu in a kendra or trikona: malefic occupant vs well-placed period lord
policies.existingRule: The occupant rule reads Rahu/Ketu in a non-upachaya house as friction; planetCondition gives the period lord +1 for a kendra/trikona house.
policies.proposedInterpretation: None proposed; the natal and timing readings answer different questions and both are kept.

sources.reference: Commentaries credit nodes in kendras/trikonas with good period results in some traditions; not verified.

policies.title: Functional roles by lordship (yogakaraka, Lagna lord, 3/6/11, 8th, 2/12, Kendradhipati, maraka)
policies.existingRule: remedies.ts functionalRoles: trikona (1,5,9) vs dusthana (6,8,12) lordship; yogakaraka = first planet owning a trikona and a kendra (so a Lagna lord owning a kendra qualifies); 3rd/11th, Kendradhipati, Sun/Moon 8th exemption and marakas ignored.
policies.proposedInterpretation: Lagna lord benefic; yogakaraka only for a planet owning a kendra (4,7,10) and a trikona (5,9); 3rd/6th/11th lords malefic; 8th lord malefic except as Lagna lord or when the Sun or Moon; 2nd/12th lords neutral (by association); kendra-only lords neutral (Kendradhipati); 2nd/7th lords marakas. See functionalRoleReview().

sources.reference: Commentaries on Laghu Parashari (e.g. the O. P. Verma English commentary's sections on the 8th lord, Kendradhipatya dosha and the Sun and Moon as 8th lords): Sun and Moon exempt from the 8th-lordship blemish; Lagna lord exempt from Kendradhipati; 2nd/12th lords give results by their other sign and associations.
The verses themselves were not checked in a primary edition.

exceptions: Rahu and Ketu own no sign here.
Natural nature of the Moon depends on paksha; of Mercury on association.
